maddeler.e:
تلتحقوا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِقُوا (taltaḥiqū) /tal.ta.ħi.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# تُلْتَحَقُوا (tultaḥaqū) /tul.ta.ħa.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
